scenario.summary: Guest opens an obsolete simple product's PDP, verifies the obsolete message, follows the replacement link and checks that the replacement product suggestions are shown.
steps: Open the webstore, search the obsolete SKU and open its PDP
Verify Read Reviews link and the obsolete message
Click the replacement link; verify the suggestion cards' details are visible
assertions: Obsolete message 'This product is obsolete. Please choose from suggested replacement products.' is shown
evidence: Independent method (no dependsOn); linked manual case Z10-TC-8879 is in the class comment, not in the scan.

Needs as the Playwright obsolete pdp entry: product -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_OBSOLETE {store}, preferred sheet SKU z-2100011 (tda rows: PimProductId 385, active, IsObsolete true, 4 ProductSuggestions links); replacement -> PRODUCT_REPLACEMENT_OF_PRODUCT_IN_STOCK {product @product.productId, quantityUsed 1, store} so the obsolete product has a suggestion to show. The method checks the suggestions structurally (visible), so the replacement need has no sources.
IsObsoleteMessage is a UI text: expected-output.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in (the CentralizedLogin group is a tag only; no login call in the method).
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); sheet SKUs were looked up read-only with bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
